# CATL v0.11.0rc1 — downloadable GitHub source snapshot (9 November 2026)

**Type:** automatically generated GitHub repository archive, **not** a GitHub
Release asset or a production-certified installer.

Download the complete tracked source at the fixed evaluation-snapshot branch:

https://github.com/BryanFiFife/CATL/archive/refs/heads/release/v0.11.0rc1-evaluation-20261109-r2.zip

This link works for viewers who are authorised to access the private
repository. It will become publicly accessible only if the owner separately
makes the repository public.

The archive is generated by GitHub from the selected branch. It includes
all tracked files and the binary overlay screenshot; no private Git clone,
GitHub Actions job, GitHub Release API upload or CLI environment is needed.
The branch is intended as an immutable *conventional snapshot*, but no
repository ruleset or signed tag currently cryptographically enforces that.
Record and verify the branch's actual commit before relying on it.

The repository contains `RELEASE_MANIFEST.json` and `SHA256SUMS.txt`,
which index the source paths in the checkout. Their checksums are for
**individual files**, not for GitHub's ZIP transport bytes.
GitHub may change ZIP wrapper metadata independently of Git-tracked content;
do not treat the ZIP SHA-256 as a reproducible build signature.

For a deterministic, stricter CATL archive, a trusted full checkout is still
needed to run:

```bash
python tools/release_pack.py --output /tmp/CATL-0.11.0rc1-source.zip
python tools/release_pack.py --verify /tmp/CATL-0.11.0rc1-source.zip
```

That stricter archive has **not** been generated or validated against the
complete current source in the isolated ChatGPT execution environment.

## Acceptance and licensing

- New scoped tests: 39/39 source-exact offline unittests, including 10,000
  deterministic hostile systemd property mutations. See
  [earlier offline evidence](LOCAL_ACCEPTANCE_2026-11-09.md) and [mount/namespace fix](MOUNT_NAMESPACE_GUARD_2026-11-09.md).
- Earlier full Linux 707-discovery acceptance evidence is historical to an
  **older commit** and was not rerun at the latest snapshot.
- Linux real-host systemd/LSM/egress, live Hermes, physical FIDO2, Windows,
  macOS, real payment/email/API readback, independent witness and third-party
  penetration testing remain **unaccepted**.
- **Private-evaluation-only licence.** Do not call this open source,
  commercially deployable or redistributed-by-default without a separately
  authorised licence change.

The connected GitHub API supports repository/branch writes but does not expose
GitHub Release creation or binary asset uploads. Consequently, this snapshot
is an immediately downloadable **source archive on GitHub**, but the separate
GitHub Releases page still has **no published entry**. Do not conflate those
states.
